components.description: Dotted-underline term that opens a definition popover on hover/focus.

components.description: Honest degraded state for a section with no rows this run.
components.css: .ds-empty { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.625rem; border: 1px dashed oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32); border-radius: 0.625rem; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; color: oklch(0.552 0.016 285.938); font-size: 0.875rem; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: A nightly report you read, not a terminal you watch. shadcn/ui zinc on Tailwind v4: near-white paper, near-black ink, hairline borders, comfortable density. Every visual element defers to a sentence of plain English; color exists only to echo what the words already said. The system rejects both its newspaper-ledger predecessor (retired 2026-07-30 as too stylized) and trading-terminal maximalism.
keyCharacteristics: Borders over shadows; flat surfaces, hairline separation
Text is the primary channel; tones reinforce, never replace
Mono tabular numerals for every number, sans for every sentence
One-sentence section notes; deep anatomy behind an About modal
Honest degraded states (dashed empty, red mono unavailable)

rules.name: The Words-First Rule
rules.body: Color never carries meaning alone. Every tone badge has a text label; every flagged row also gets a ★ suffix. If removing all color would lose information, the design is wrong.

rules.name: The Three-Tones Rule
rules.body: Up, down, hold — that is the entire semantic palette. New signal states map into these three; never mint a fourth color.

rules.name: The Mono-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every numeral the user might compare or scan is mono with tabular-nums and right-aligned in tables. Sans numerals are permitted only inside running prose.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional text below 0.75rem, ever, and nothing below full muted-foreground contrast. A hint too small or too faint to pass AA is a hint that doesn't exist.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the element is temporally floating (tooltip, popover, dialog). Nothing that rests in the page flow casts one.

dos: Do keep section notes to ONE sentence of meaning; move all widget anatomy to the About modal.
Do read page width from --page-width (72rem) everywhere, including components outside .page like StaleBanner.
Do cap prose at 75ch even when the card is page-wide.
Do render partial data as empty/unavailable states; a missing section must say so.
donts: Don't revive newspaper ornament: no serif display, no brass accents, no margin gutters.
Don't build trading-terminal maximalism: no dense blinking grids, no neon-on-black, no data density as identity.
Don't put counts in tab labels.
Don't ship 2-point sparklines or zero-baseline sparkline domains.
Don't use color as the only signal; every tone needs a text twin.
Don't add resting shadows, side-stripe borders, or gradient text; separation is a 1px hairline, emphasis is weight.
